purpose: Identify candidate score sources for a future rights-reviewed Choro research subset without importing, transcribing, or analyzing the score contents.

sources.title: Chorinho
sources.scope: historical candidate; piano solo; one short score entry
sources.source_stated_rights: IMSLP page labels the score Public Domain and records first publication as Rio de Janeiro: O Malho, No. 840, 1918.
sources.fit: Potential historical score for testing notation-to-symbolic-analysis mechanics; piano solo alone is not representative of ensemble Choro.
unresolved: Confirm source scan and publication provenance.

sources.title: Choro mineiro
sources.scope: contemporary Choro; page describes open instrumentation including flute, guitar and cavaquinho
sources.source_stated_rights: IMSLP page identifies the composer-typeset score as Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.
sources.fit: Promising contemporary, ensemble-oriented candidate; still a single piece and not a representative corpus.
unresolved: Verify that the CC BY 4.0 notice applies to the exact downloadable score and all included material.

sources.title: Choros Songbook (14 choros)
sources.scope: contemporary guitar-led collection of 14 works by one composer
sources.source_stated_rights: IMSLP page identifies the composer-typeset collection as Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.
sources.fit: Potentially useful for a small contemporary-authorized test set; selection is composer-specific and cannot establish general Choro characteristics.
unresolved: Verify exact license file/notice on the work to be used and whether the underlying compositions and annotations are all covered.
Confirm attribution requirements and provenance for every selected work.
Do not generalize a single-composer collection to the full Choro tradition.

sources.title: Chóra, chóra, choradô (Samba Rio-Grandense)
sources.scope: boundary/control item; vocal/chorus/piano and cataloged as Samba, not a clean core Choro example
sources.source_stated_rights: IMSLP page labels this score Public Domain; it also states the alternative title Samba Rio-Grandense and lists voice, chorus and piano.
sources.fit: Possible boundary/control study to test whether intake and labeling preserve neighboring styles; not to be counted as core Choro evidence.
unresolved: Confirm territorial rights and source provenance.
The title/categorization itself flags overlap with Samba; obtain specialist guidance before classifying it as Choro.
Keep separate from the core candidate set unless an expert-defined scope justifies inclusion.

sources.title: 12 Exercícios brasileiros (including Chôrinho)
sources.scope: historical pedagogical collection of 12 Brazilian pieces; piano four-hands; one listed movement is titled Chôrinho
sources.source_stated_rights: IMSLP labels the score Public Domain; the catalog record attributes the scan to Instituto Piano Brasileiro and lists Ricordi publication metadata. This is a catalog signal only, not clearance of the exact edition, scan, or all jurisdictions.
sources.fit: Adds an independent composer and a named Chôrinho movement for a bounded notation-method pilot and selection-robustness check. The pedagogical piano-four-hands setting is not representative of ensemble Choro.
unresolved: Verify that the stated rights cover the exact edition and digitized file, and identify any third-party editorial material.
Review the underlying compositions, edition, and scan separately for every intended jurisdiction and use.
Treat the named Chôrinho as one movement in a pedagogical collection; do not treat the whole collection as an ensemble Choro sample.
No score content has been downloaded, copied, transcribed, or analyzed.

sources.title: Choro p'ra Portinari
sources.scope: modern guitar solo; score typeset by Musica Brasilis in 2025; editor George Svetlichny
sources.source_stated_rights: IMSLP lists the 2025 Musica Brasilis typesetting as Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 and names an editor. This catalog notice does not independently establish that every underlying and edition right is held by the licensor.
sources.fit: Adds a distinct contemporary composer and guitar-only notation context for studying whether score-analysis procedures generalize beyond piano or one composer. A solo guitar score is not representative of ensemble Choro.

global_gates: No source is marked rights-cleared in this inventory.
IMSLP catalogue metadata is a lead, not legal advice or a substitute for reviewing the exact file's rights notice.
Evaluate composition, score engraving/transcription, scan, recording, lyrics, and metadata rights separately where relevant.
Confirm territorial status for each intended use and document license version, attribution, and permitted outputs.
Do not download, transcribe, ingest, or analyze any item until the intended use and source-specific rights review are recorded.
Even a permissively licensed score does not make a one-composer or piano-only sample representative of the living Choro tradition.
non_goals: This inventory is not permission to use or reproduce any score.
This inventory does not create a training dataset or represent the scores as analyzed.
This inventory does not change Choro's proposal-only state or create a composer route.
